content.rendered:
At Averon Trust, there’s no such thing as a small business

No matter the size of your business, it’s a big deal to you. Our team is here to give you the products and services — and guidance — you need to grow. After all, you have the same goals as any other business, so why shouldn’t you have the same tools?

Averon Trust treated me with the respect of a valid business person. The Bank was supportive of me, my business and my needs from the very first meeting.
– Stacey Marcell, Northeast Horticultural Services

We work to understand your business.

We know that no two businesses are the same. We’ll work with you to understand your business, how you want to grow and how we can apply the right solutions to get you there.

Open an account

Whether in-person or virtually, a business banking specialist can help customize the Averon Trust banking experience to your needs and finalize the account-opening process.

Open An Account

Checking

We offer a range of checking accounts, including free, relationship, business analysis, sweep, non-profit and more, to fit your needs.

Explore checking

Savings

We support your business savings goals with Business Savings, Money Market, and Investment Sweep Accounts, Business CDs, and more.

Explore Savings

Cash Management

Use our secure cash management solutions to streamline collections, investments and disbursement of funds.

Explore Cash Management

Loans

We’re a SBA Preferred Lender, and with good reason. Our commitment to prospective business owners has helped hundreds of driven individuals to open and operate successful businesses in our community.

Explore Loans

Digital Banking

Loan, business banking services, advanced technology solutions and more — all geared to your business’s long-term growth.

Explore Digital Banking
